verses.1: And Jehovah made a great fish that could swallow Yonah. So Yonah was in the mouth of the fish for three days and three nights.
verses.2: And Yona prayed to the LORD his God from the bottom of the valley.
verses.3: And he said, “I have called out to the LORD for help. He answered me from the depths of His mercy. You have heard my voice.”
verses.4: And they threw me into the depths of the sea and a river; all your waters swept over me, and your waves covered me.
verses.5: And I said, “I am being driven away from your presence.” But I will continue to look towards your holy temple.
verses.6: The waters overwhelmed me, up to my hair; they covered me completely.
verses.7: To the inhabitants of the mountains, I descended to the earth in my flight, forever. May the Lord, my God, heal my wounds.
verses.8: As my soul is filled with sorrow, I remember Jehovah. My prayers come before you, to your holy dwelling.
verses.9: May those who guard the treasures of kindness be blessed.
verses.10: And I will sing praises to You with a loud voice. I will worship You, for You have saved me from my enemies.
verses.11: And the LORD said to the dove, “Come here.” And she came down to the ground.
